notes.title: Demons are coming! Small Update
notes.notes:
I have fixed some bugs:
-You can now change the resolution and display mode in game, not just main menu
-Adjusting music volume now works as intended
-Ui now scales properly with wider monitors
-Fixed spelling mistakes

notes.title: Demons are coming! Release
notes.notes:
Demons are coming! is now released! Enjoy defeating those nasty demons to protect your people! See unique and clever builds that traumatize every single enemy.

Thank you all who supported me on this journey. I have worked hard on this game and I hope you can see it.

notes.title: Demo Update
notes.notes:
I have updated the demo to include new content.
It contains 2 new bosses, 25 upgrades and 9 enemys.

The game is not finished yet, you can suggest anything you like in the feedback menu. If you have enjoyed playing it, consider leaving a wishlist.
